title: A Global Academic Achievement for the UAE
html:
New York University Appoints Abdulsalam AlMadani as Professor

More than 200 International Organizations and Syndicates Convene at AEEDC Dubai, Affirming the Event’s Global Specialised Status

Dubai, United Arab Emirates – January 20, 2026: New York University appointed His Excellency Ambassador Dr. Abdulsalam AlMadani as Professor at its campus in the United States of America, during its participation in AEEDC Dubai 2026, making him the first Emirati to be appointed to this prestigious academic position. H.E. AlMadani serves as the Roving Ambassador of the Parliamentary Assembly of the Mediterranean (PAM) for the GCC Region, Chairman of AEEDC Dubai and the Global Scientific Dental Alliance (GSDA), and Chairman of the International Congress for Health Specialties (ICHS). This appointment comes in recognition of his distinguished scientific and professional career, his notable contributions to education, the medical sector, and professional development, and his prominent role in strengthening international cooperation among scientific and medical institutions worldwide.

The participation of New York University in AEEDC Dubai 2026 holds special significance, as it is a continuation of a long-standing partnership spanning over 30 years between the university and this scientific international event. This reflects NYU’s commitment to supporting medical education and innovating modern scientific solutions in the field of dentistry.

The announcement was made at the 23rd Global Scientific Dental Alliance Meeting, one of the world’s most prominent gatherings of elite experts, specialists, and policymakers in the dental sector, underscoring the leadership role of Professor AlMadani in uniting international efforts to advance education, healthcare, and professional innovation on both regional and international levels.

His Excellency Ambassador Professor Abdulsalam AlMadani was honored in the presence of high-ranking dignitaries from the United Arab Emirates and the United States of America, as well as prominent local and international figures. Also attending were heads of delegations participating in AEEDC Dubai 2026, the world’s largest specialised dental conference and exhibition, currently holding its 30th edition in Dubai.

Expressing his pride and happiness, H.E. Amb. Professor Abdulsalam AlMadani said, “I am deeply grateful for this scientific and academic recognition from New York University, which reflects the international appreciation for our efforts in developing the medical sector and enhancing the continuing education system. This honour is not just a personal achievement; it is a recognition of the vital role Emirati talent can play in advancing the medical and higher education sectors globally.”

He added: “This recognition serves as an incentive to continue supporting high-quality scientific research, expanding knowledge exchange, and building influential academic partnerships. It also solidifies the UAE’s position as a global hub for science and knowledge, reflecting its vision of investing in people as the foundation for sustainable development.”

This achievement is another testament to the UAE’s sustained efforts in education, scientific research, and medical innovation, and affirms the United Arab Emirates’ leadership and its distinguished global standing within the international academic and scientific community.

The Global Scientific Dental Alliance (GSDA) continues to strengthen its position as a leading scientific pillar of AEEDC Dubai 2026, reaffirming its role as a global platform that brings together dental experts and institutions from around the world to help shape the future of dentistry and advance oral health at the international level.

The 23rd meeting of GSDA was held during the second day of AEEDC Dubai and witnessed the participation of 438 high-level representatives from dental associations and syndicates, universities, ministries, health authorities, and the private sector. The participants represented 211 member organizations from more than 45 countries, working together to enhance international cooperation and exchange scientific expertise. Discussions focused on recommendations grounded in the latest scientific research, with the aim of presenting innovative solutions and advancing educational and professional standards, reflecting GSDA’s standing on the global stage.

GSDA coordinates a comprehensive scientific agenda that covers the latest topics in the field, including artificial intelligence in dentistry, robotic surgery, and digital workflows. It also serves as a platform for member states to exchange successful clinical experiences and best practices, which are subsequently integrated into the conference’s continuing education programs.

In addition, GSDA highlights the achievements of its member organizations and members within their local communities, where representatives actively contribute to education, research, humanitarian initiatives, and policy development, transforming global dialogue into tangible local impact. These efforts reflect the Alliance’s commitment to raising standards of care and promoting professional excellence.

Moreover, guided by its strategic vision and ongoing commitment to excellence, the Global Scientific Dental Alliance (GSDA) continues to advance oral health through constructive dialogue and strategic partnerships that unite all stakeholders within the international dental community.

Through providing a trusted platform for interaction and collaboration, GSDA supports sustainable progress that transcends borders and disciplines, reinforcing its position as a leading platform for professional growth, leadership, and innovation at both the regional and international levels.

Managed by the International Congress for Health Specialties (ICHS), the continued success of the Global Scientific Dental Alliance is attributed to the dedication, collaboration, and commitment of its members worldwide. The 23rd annual meeting further emphasized the importance of public health awareness, oral disease prevention, and international cooperation in advancing scientific research and continuing education in dentistry.

About the Global Scientific Dental Alliance (GSDA):

It is a non-profit, non-political organization that works to build a network of dental specialists and stakeholders. It aims to support scientific and professional cooperation between countries and medical societies to improve general oral health and community well-being globally.
